# Vue Best Practices Workflow

Curated by Skill Harbor — an ordered workflow for Vue tasks: confirm the architecture first (Vue 3 + Composition API + `<script setup lang="ts">` as the standard, unless the project explicitly requires Options API or JSX), plan component boundaries with one-sentence responsibilities and explicit props/emits contracts, then apply the core foundations (one source of truth, props-down/events-up, small focused components, deliberate computed/watcher use) — with must-read core references on reactivity, SFCs, data flow and composables kept active through the whole task. By @vuejs-ai, listed here with credit to its creator; 39,898 installs make it one of the most-used skills in this catalog wave. Honest caveats: community-maintained by the vuejs-ai project, not the official Vue.js team — it still tracks the documented Vue 3 idioms; version 18.0.0 of the source. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
